b.2ba9da6d31:
<h>Martyrologium</h>
<c>S</c>exto Idus Septémbris Luna séptima. Anno Dómini 2027
<h>N</h>atívitas beatissimæ semper Vírginis Genitrícis Dei Maríæ.
<h>S</h>ancti Hadriáni Mártyris; cuius dies natális quarto Nonas Mártii recensétur, sed festívitas hac die, qua sacrum eius corpus Romam translátum fuit, potíssime celebrátur.
<h>V</h>aléntiæ, in Hispánia Tarraconénsi, natális sancti Thomæ a Villa Nova, ex Eremitárum sancti Augustíni Ordine, Epíscopi et Confessóris, insígnis propter flagrántem in páuperes caritátem; qui ab Alexándro Papa Séptimo in Sanctórum númerum adscríptus est. Ipsíus autem festum décimo Kaléndas Octóbris celebrátur.
<h>A</h>lexandríæ sanctórum Mártyrum Ammónis, Theóphili, Neotérii et aliórum vigínti duórum.
<h>A</h>ntiochíæ sanctórum Timóthei et Fausti Mártyrum.
<h>G</h>azæ, in Palæstína, sanctórum Mártyrum fratrum Eusébii, Néstabi et Zenónis; qui, témpore Iuliáni Apóstatæ, irruénte in eos turba Gentílium, discérpti atque necáti sunt.
<h>I</h>bídem sancti Néstoris Mártyris, qui sub eódem Iuliáno, ab iísdem Gentílibus furéntibus sævíssime cruciátus, emísit spíritum.
<h>R</h>omæ sancti Sérgii Primi, Papæ et Confessóris.
<h>F</h>risíngæ sancti Corbiniáni, qui fuit primus eiúsdem civitátis Epíscopus. Hic, a sancto Gregório Secúndo Pontífice ordinátus et ad prædicándum Evangélium missus, úberes fructus in Gállia et Germánia rétulit, ac demum, virtútibus et miráculis clarus, in pace quiévit.
<h>C</h>arthágine nova, in América meridionáli, sancti Petri Claver, Sacerdótis e Societáte Iesu et Confessóris; qui mira sui abnegatióne et exímia caritáte Nigrítis in servitútem abdúctis, annos ámplius quadragínta, óperam impéndens, tercénta fere eórum míllia Christo sua ipse manu regenerávit; et a Leóne Décimo tértio, Pontífice Máximo, in Sanctórum númerum relátus est, ac dein étiam cæléstis Patrónus peculiáris sacrárum ad Nigrítas Missiónum constitútus et declarátus.
<r>℣.</r> Et álibi aliórum plurimórum sanctórum Mártyrum et Confessórum, atque sanctárum Vírginum.
<r>℟.</r> Deo grátias.
b.701e0895a9:
<h>Martyrology</h>
<c>S</c>eptember 8th 2027, the 7th day of the Moon,
<h>O</h>n the morrow we commemorate the birth of the Most Blessed Mary, always a Virgin, Mother of God.
<h>U</h>pon the same 8th day of September, were born into the better life:
<h>U</h>pon the same day are commemorated the holy martyr Adrian, and twenty-three others, who finished their testimony at Nicomedia after many sufferings, under the Emperors Diocletian and Maximian, by having their legs broken, upon the 4th day of March. Their relics were carried by the Christians to Byzantium, where they were buried with reverence and honour, and thence the body of holy Adrian was afterwards brought to Rome, upon the 8th of this month, upon which day the chief feast is kept in his honour.
<h>A</h>t Valencia, in Spain, holy Thomas of Villanueva, Archbishop (of that city,) famous for his exceeding charity toward the poor. His name was enrolled among those of the Saints by Pope Alexander VII, and we keep his feast upon the 22nd day of this present month of September.
<h>A</h>t Alexandria, the holy martyrs Ammon, Theophilus, Neoterius, and twenty-two others.
<h>A</h>t Antioch, the holy martyrs Timothy and Faustus.
<h>A</h>t Gaza, in Palestine, the holy brethren Eusebius, Nestabus, and Zeno, all martyrs, in the time of the Emperor Julian the Apostate.
<h>A</h> multitude of the Gentiles fell upon them, rent them, and slew them.
<h>T</h>here also the holy martyr Nestor, who was most cruelly tormented by the same raging Gentiles, under the same Emperor Julian, and gave up the ghost.
<h>A</h>t Rome, (in the year 701,) the holy Confessor Pope Sergius I.
<h>A</h>t Frisingen, holy Corbinian, first Bishop of that city. He was ordained and sent forth to preach the Gospel by Pope Gregory II. He bore much fruit in Gaul and in Germany, and at length fell asleep in peace, famous for graces and wonders.
<h>A</h>t Cartagena, in South America, (in the year 1654,) the holy Confessor Peter Claver, of the Society of Jesus, who toiled for more than forty years among the negro slaves with marvellous self-sacrifice and exceeding love, and of them with his own hand caused nearly three hundred thousand to be born again in Christ. His name was enrolled by the Supreme Pontiff Leo XIII among those of the Saints.
<r>℣.</r> And elsewhere many other holy martyrs, confessors, and holy virgins.
<r>℟.</r> Thanks be to God.
